# F-star residue (i-prime): cancellation lines - tie lemma, insertion-finite mixing, fixture settlement, and the corrected dyadic corollary (no kappa)

## Scope

Kappa-blocker **KB5f** (authorized explicit open request from the [handoff thread](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166); scope changed from the drawn card and recorded in `TASK.json`): the **cancellation-line residue (i-prime)** of open problem **F-star** of the merged `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas` package ([PR 1590](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1590), section 7, OPEN: `cert(M) >= floor(2v/3)` for every exact 3-total rational decoder `M = sum_{j<=3} p_j q_j^T`) - the case where more than `floor(v/3)` lines have `v_2(M_tt) > gamma` ("cancellation lines", [PR 2869](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2869)'s rename), so the mod-2 anchor is short of the threshold - **plus** the small corrective repair it depends on: [PR 2717](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2717)'s dyadic-corollary normalization gap, which PR 2869 found and this package reproduces and fixes.

Package `research/fstar-cancellation-lines-seed80d69336/`. **F-star itself is not proved and not refuted here.** Claims are labelled PROVEN / CHECKED / DEMOTED.

## CORE: the cancellation-line verdict

**Verdict: on both canonical fixtures and on every searched instance, F-star holds despite the cancellation lines, certified by a coefficient-free certificate (Lemma MP matched pivots); the true residual obstruction is isolated as the *family gap* `named(M) < cert(M)`, not a threshold failure.**

| quantity | `tied_min` (12 lines) | `cex_min_1` (19 lines) |
|---|---|---|
| cancellation lines | 12 of 12 | 11 of 19 |
| anchor reach `S_gamma` | 0 of 12 | 8 of 19 |
| threshold `floor(2v/3)` | 8 | 12 |
| Lemma MP (exhaustive pivot maps) | 9 (4096 maps) | 16 (6144 maps) |
| Lemma CL3 insertion mixing | 9 (no anchor lines exist) | 16 (5 of 8 anchors placeable at best config; 7 seen) |
| engine / stored witness | 11 | 18 |
| family gap `cert - named` | 2 | 2 |

`tied_min` is all cancellation lines with anchor reach 0 and `cex_min_1` is four anchors short of threshold; in both, the matched-pivot certificate alone reaches `9 >= 8` and `16 >= 12`, with no anchor, no repairs and no search. Cancellation lines do not obstruct the threshold in these instances; the pivot structure carries it.

**PROVEN - Lemma CT (what a cancellation line is).** With `tau(t) = #{j : v_2(p_j(t) q_j(t)) = gamma}` (the tie number, invariant per total): `t` is anchored exactly when `tau(t)` is odd, and `t` is a cancellation line exactly when `tau(t)` is even (`tau` in `{0, 2}`); every tied total lies in `D(t)`, so a `tau = 2` line has `|D(t)| >= 2` and a `|D(t)| = 1` line is pivot-bit-forced (every `K_tt = 1` labelling carries the unique `D(t)` bit on both sides; the matched pivot attains it). `tau = 2` is exactly the tied-minima obstruction named in `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas` section 7.

**PROVEN - Lemma CL3 (insertion-finite mixing; answers PR 2747's open question 2).** Lemma MX mixes anchor lines and matched pivots only in two block orders; its general order has a closed form. A set of anchor lines inserts at valid cuts of one pivot order exactly when the joint demand digraph (pivot conflicts, plus `L(x)`-before-`x` and `x`-before-`R(x)` for each anchor line `x`) is acyclic, and then `cert(M) >= |A| + sum_i MAS(Z[C_i])`. Anchor-anchor conflicts vanish always (scope identity `K0 = M' mod 2 = 0` at incidences), so insertions interact only through the shared order. On `cex_min_1` (bounded scan of `2^20` mixing configurations, `A = S_gamma` level exhaustive, exact joint insertion on the top 32): up to 5 of 8 anchor lines placeable at the best configuration and 7 in some configuration, but the mixed value stays 16 - insertion power is real (the two block orders fail completely, 6144/6144, per PR 2747's record) and adds nothing over pure pivots there.

**The true residual obstruction (precise definition).** Let `named(M)` be the largest certificate value carried by the union of named families: Lemma SG anchor, Lemma MX one-sided repairs, Lemma MP matched pivots, and Lemma CL3 insertion mixings (every value carries a replayed L8 witness). The residual obstruction of residue (i-prime) is an instance with `named(M) < floor(2v/3) <= cert(M)`; the strict form `cert(M) < floor(2v/3)` is a falsifier to F-star. The threshold form was **not realized** in 178 records (falsifier criterion armed everywhere, never fired). The realized form is the **family gap** `named(M) < cert(M)`: 9 vs 11 and 16 vs 18 on the fixtures (exactly 2 on each) and +1 on the hardest re-split. The attaining witnesses use labels outside the anchor/repair/pivot families (PR 2747's open question 3); a proof of F-star must either prove the matched-pivot floor `max_c sum_i MAS(Z[C_i]) >= floor(2v/3)` for every realizable pattern (PR 2747's open question 1; witnessed on all 178 records and at 9/12, 16/19 on the fixtures) or master those two-bit labels.

## CHECKED: calibration, search, and the re-split probe

Calibration reproduces every recorded anchor first: PR 2717 (`tied_min` 11/12, `cex_min_1` 18/19, chain 22 on the stored pairing), PR 2747 (MP/MX 9 and 16 exhaustive over 4096/6144 pivot maps), PR 2869 (reach = anchor_good exactly, 0/12 and 8/19), PR 2890 (`PASS_FC4_CALIBRATION tied_min=11/12 cex_min_1=18/19 mp=9/16 chain=22` values).

Smallest-first falsifier search across decoders with 1..v cancellation lines (`v = 3..12`, exact `k = 1..v`, deterministic seeds):

| family | domain | records | falsifiers | min named ratio |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| parity-engineered | `v = 3..12`, `k = 1..v` exact | 75 | 0 | 1.000 |
| structured (tied_min signature) | `v = 3..12`, `k = 1..v` exact | 34 | 0 | 1.000 |
| adversary (minimizing the pivot floor) | `k > floor(v/3)`, `v = 3..11` | 44 | 0 | 1.000 |
| GL_3(Z) re-splits of the fixtures | fixture-density `Z` | 24 + 1 | 0 | 0.895 |

Falsifier criterion (armed on every record): exact `cert < floor(2v/3)` where exhaustive a-enumeration terminates, or an explicit admissible `B` with chain cost below threshold (the proven chain of `research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas`); never fired. Exact generator obstruction, recorded: random and structured factorizations give sparse zero digraphs (arcs need `|pi(t) intersect sigma(s)| >= 2` by Lemma RK (c)), so the named families reach `cert = v` there and the fixture-density hardness resists random construction - a scoped statement about the searched generators, not an unrealizability claim. `GL_3(Z)` re-splits keep the fixtures' dense `Z` (MAS 4 of 12, 10 of 19) while moving `gamma`, supports and `S_gamma`; there the named floor dips to `17/19 = 0.895 v` with engine +1 on the hardest, and the cancellation counts seen are 11 and 12 only (the diagonal valuations are re-split invariant). The CL3 fixture evaluation is a bounded scan (20000 of 2^20 configurations), not an exhaustive maximum.

## CORRECTIVE: the dyadic corollary's normalization gap, reproduced and repaired

PR 2717 proved Lemma AN under the hypothesis "after per-total powers of two the factorization is 2-integral: all entries of `p, q` lie in `Z_(2)`" and closed with: *"Under the added hypothesis that at most `floor(v/3)` lines have `M_tt` even, `cert(M) >= ceil(2v/3)`, so **F-star holds for dyadic decoders with at most one-third even diagonals**."* PR 2869 found the gap; this package reproduces it (control SC1) and states the fix.

**The gap, exhibited.** On two lines with `p = q = (1/2)(1, 1)` all entries are dyadic, but the total content is `c_1 = -2`, the per-total rescaling interval `[-m_1, n_1] = [1, -1]` is empty, and no per-total power of two makes both factors 2-integral - so the mod-2 reduction `p mod 2` Lemma AN applies is not even defined on `p(t) = 1/2`. Dyadic entryhood does not deliver Lemma AN's hypothesis. The count phrase has a second gap (control SC2): `M = 2 I_3` has three even diagonals (naive count 0 anchored) while the corrected reach is 3 (`gamma = 1`); "even diagonals" is not the anchor count when `gamma != 0`.

**Corrected dyadic corollary (PROVEN, from PR 2869's Lemmas SC/SG).** For every exact 3-total rational decoder in any entry class: `cert(M) >= |S_gamma| = v - #{t : v_2(M_tt) > gamma}` with `gamma = min_j c_j` and `c_j` the 2-adic content of total `j`; F-star holds on `M` whenever at most `floor(v/3)` lines are cancellation lines. Lemma AN's literal hypothesis holds exactly when `c_j >= 0` for every total (Lemma SC (b)) - a condition on the factorization, not a consequence of dyadic entryhood - and when it fails the single global rescaling `M -> 2^{-gamma} M` restores it (Lemma SG (a)). The anchored set is `S_gamma = {t : v_2(M_tt) = gamma}`; it equals the odd-diagonal set exactly when `gamma = 0`.

A corrective comment with this content is posted on PR 2717 (the authorized remedy; its branch is not edited and no follow-up PR is opened for it).
